## Human-judgment checks — deliberately NOT automated

| Check | Why a gate cannot decide it |
|---|---|
| Does the S02 scenario carry meaningful tension? | A gate can confirm a question mark and a source-backed answer. It cannot judge whether the problem is one a contractor would actually face. |
| Does the dialogue read as natural Malay speech? | Register, idiom and rhythm are editorial judgments; no assertion available here distinguishes fluent dialogue from stilted dialogue. |
| Is the visual direction right for this topic? | RP-104 can be checked (a direction must come from a source figure). Whether the resulting image teaches the point is a design judgment. |
| Are the quiz distractors plausible but wrong? | A gate can check counts, kinds and row citations. Plausibility is subject expertise. |
| Is the chosen interaction treatment the best one? | The packet proposes a treatment from the module's repeated structure. Whether a different pattern teaches better is Bariah's call. |
